annotations.title: Inspection statistics for a car model

description: Model-wide periodic inspection statistics (how often a make and model fails or gets findings), with source, as-of date and the citation line to use. Not about one specific car: for that use vehicle_check.

country.description: Country of the register: nl, gb, il, is or dk

language.description: Optional two-letter language for the texts, for example nl, en, he, is, da. Unsupported values fall back to the country's default.
